definitions.explanation: Suffix attached to nouns to indicate a side, direction, or perspective. Can indicate physical location (left side, right side) or abstract perspective (the customer's side, the company's side).

examples.japanese: {右|みぎ}{側|がわ}を{歩|ある}いてください。
examples.english: Please walk on the right side.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}{側|がわ}の{席|せき}がいいです。
examples.english: I'd like a seat on the window side.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}{側|がわ}は{反対|はんたい}している。

notes:
COMMON COMBINATIONS:
- {右|みぎ}{側|がわ} (right side)
- {左|ひだり}{側|がわ} (left side)
- {向|む}こう{側|がわ} (the other side, opposite side)
- こちら{側|がわ} (this side)
- {窓|まど}{側|がわ} (window side)
- {通路|つうろ}{側|がわ} (aisle side)
- {山|やま}{側|がわ} (mountain side)
- {海|うみ}{側|がわ} (sea side)

ABSTRACT USES:
- {客|きゃく}{側|がわ} (customer's side/perspective)
- {会社|かいしゃ}{側|がわ} (company's side)
- {親|おや}{側|がわ} (parents' side)

RELATED: {裏側|うらがわ} (back side, reverse), {表側|おもてがわ} (front side).
